call.title: Introductory call transcript
call.text:
I DO! VENDOR INTRODUCTION
Call transcript | November 1, 2026, 10:00 a.m.
Rep: Jamie Rivera | Vendor: Casey Reed, Juniper Grove
FICTIONAL SAMPLE SOURCE

[00:00] Jamie: Tell me about what you do and who you are a good fit for.
[00:19] Casey Reed: We offer Indoor and outdoor ceremonies, reception hall, getting-ready suites. Our style is Modern rustic; oak grove ceremony; indoor reception. Capacity-wise, 180 seated guests; 150 with indoor dance floor.

[02:10] Jamie: Walk me through what's included and what you need.
[02:22] Casey Reed: Standard service is 12-hour venue access. The team is One venue manager; client hires event coordinator. We can customize with Furniture layouts; ceremony locations; vendor selection. Exclusions are Catering, alcohol, rentals beyond listed furniture. From the venue or client, we need Licensed caterer; insured vendors; shuttle plan for offsite guests.

[06:05] Jamie: How do bookings and payments work?
[06:20] Casey Reed: The deposit is 30% non-refundable retainer. The balance is due 30 days before the event. We recommend booking 9–12 months ahead.
[07:02] Jamie: And changes or cancellations?
[07:14] Casey Reed: Retainer is non-refundable; within 30 days the full balance is due. For rescheduling: One date change within 12 months, subject to availability.

[09:35] Jamie: What happens on the day?
[09:46] Casey Reed: Vendor access from 10 a.m.; all collection by midnight. Our backup plan is Indoor ceremony option for up to 150 guests; generator hookup.
[10:50] Jamie: What about delivery and deadlines?
[11:02] Casey Reed: The deadline on the website is vague. I will send the actual planning or fulfillment deadline. I'll email you the latest timeline.

[13:12] Jamie: Please also confirm the package prices and send insurance documentation.
[13:25] Casey Reed: The website rates are out of date. I'll send our current rate card and a follow-up email. I still need to send our certificate.

[14:00] Jamie: Thanks. We will keep the profile pending until the documents are reviewed.

Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8

Hi Jamie,

Thanks for the call yesterday. Please use $8,500 as our current entry starting price. The website's $7,500 rate is from last season; the attached 2027 rate card has the correct packages.

Our confirmed delivery / planning timeline is: Final floor plan due 30 days before event. Please use this instead of the old or incomplete timeline discussed on the call.

Best,
Casey Reed
